credits.title: Go for Broke 2
credits.overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

credits.title: The Fire Raven

credits.title: Gezhi Town
credits.overview: A group of Chinese refugees and straggler soldiers, led by a machinist, defend their mountain town, "Gezhi," against a surprise attack by Japanese reconnaissance troops in a desperate fight using civilian ingenuity against a trained military force.

credits.title: The Volunteers: Peace at Last
credits.overview: Set during the final phase of the War to Resist U.S. and Aid Korea, the film depicts the tense final battles and simultaneous peace negotiations leading to the armistice, capturing the spirit of perseverance and sacrifice on both the battlefield and the diplomatic front.

credits.title: Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants
credits.overview: Under Genghis Khan, the Mongolian army pushes west to destroy the Jin Dynasty, setting its sights on the Song Dynasty next. Amid internal conflicts among martial arts schools, Guo Jing unites the Central Plains' warriors to defend Xiangyang, embodying courage and loyalty in the fight for the nation.

credits.title: A Place Called Silence
credits.overview: Chen Yutong, a girl's middle school student, was bullied at school, but her mother Li Han was unable to save her daughter from the "hell." Everyone around her turned a blind eye, and a collective silence brewed greater violence.

credits.title: Hovering Blade
credits.overview: Following the brutal rape and murder of his teenage daughter, a single father seeks revenge against the responsible youths. His pursuit for justice becomes a deadly cat-and-mouse game with both the perpetrators and the police.

credits.title: Article 20
credits.overview: Tells the story of prosecutor Han Ming who is involved in a difficult case where the intentional injury of people is turned into a legitimate defense.

credits.title: Moscow Mission
credits.overview: Tough Chinese detectives go on a mission to Moscow to hunt down ruthless robbers who have been plaguing the trans-Siberian railway with violence and chaos.

credits.title: Raid on the Lethal Zone
credits.overview: In the 1990s, an armed police team in the south-western border of China encounter floods and drug traffickers while on a mission, resulting in heavy casualties. In order to avenge their dead comrades, the survivors launched a final confrontation against the drug dealers.

credits.title: One and Only
credits.overview: After getting recruited by a veteran street dancer, an aspiring breakdancer will do whatever it takes to prove he can make his way to the top.

credits.title: Ping-Pong: The Triumph
credits.overview: In the early 1990s when the Chinese men's table tennis team is at a low ebb, head coach Cai Zhenhua is tasked with forming a new team to finally fight to the top at the 1995 World Ping Championship in Tianjin, China.

credits.title: Schemes in Antiques
credits.overview: Despite his family’s famed expertise on ancient relics, Xu Yuan makes a simple living as the owner of an electronics shop, eager to distinguish himself from a disgraced ancestor who was executed for treason after stealing a Chinese artifact for Japan. credits.title: Mr. Donkey
credits.overview: In order to pay for the donkey that brings them water, a countryside village registers it as a teacher at its local school.  But when the charity group that funds the school visits for an inspection, the village has to find ways to hide their secret.
